name: Anthony Hargrove
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 5B

items.text: Anthony Hargrove runs programs that help dropouts return to school. His campaign says he worked for Chicago Public Schools for over 20 years as a culinary instructor, dean, operations manager, and compliance specialist. He wants to make improving reading and math skills the district's top priority, setting clear goals and tracking progress. He supports improving special education and expanding career and vocational education. He opposes the Chicago Public Schools practice of raising property taxes by the maximum allowed each year. He says the district should create more community partnerships to use underutilized school buildings.
